summary: Added the missing west side for the RP-0914 transfers of HX-1003, HX-1006 and HX-1013, then refilled 18 eligible west items from north and east. Seven items (HX-1009, 1022, 1023, 1030, 1035, 1039, 1050) could not be fully covered and are in shortfall.csv. For HX-1009 I over-added to west because the item read showed stale east stock, then corrected it with an extra -60 net adjustment on west.
